newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila ready to take delivery of U.S. rice.
newsitem.headline: Manila ready to take delivery of U.S. rice.

text.p: The Philippines is expected to take delivery of 12,738 tonnes of U.S. rice this week, officials at the Agriculture Department said on Monday.
The U.S. rice, supplied by trading firm Cargill, Continental Grains and Garnac, is set arrive in Manila on March 7, a department official told Reuters.
Officials said the U.S. rice was contracted last year under Title 1 of the U.S. government's PL 480 programme.
Title 1, also known as the Food for Peace Programme, is a loan programme for the purchase of farm goods with low interest rates and long-term payback periods.
